lines.text: At Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem and found men selling cattle, sheep, and doves in the temple courts.
Jesus made a whip out of reeds, drove out the sheep and cattle, and overturned the money changers' tables.
His disciples remembered the Scripture about zeal for God's house, and the Jews demanded a sign to prove His authority.
Jesus said He would raise the temple in three days, and the Jews said it took forty years to build.
After He was raised, His disciples remembered, but Jesus did not entrust Himself to them, for He knew them all.
